realtime_memories.content: Single Next.js app (apps/www) with middleware subdomain→route rewrites. Subdomains (thoughts, dev, links, updates, metrics, status, lab, docs) route to /[subdomain] paths internally. Route groups: (main)/ and (subdomain)/ both use identical Navbar+Footer layout. Navigation uses ExpandableNav with primaryItems (index, work, thoughts, connect) + expandable full list. Shared packages: @anipotts/lib, @anipotts/ui, @anipotts/types, @anipotts/styles, @anipotts/config.

Accent colors via CSS vars: lavender #a78bfa (light), blue #61abea (dark). Tailwind config uses var(--accent-400) NOT hardcoded hex. Dynamic favicons per subdomain (next/og ImageResponse): ap, th, dv, lk, up, mt, st, lb, dc. Handles: @anipottsbuilds (social), @anipotts (GitHub/LinkedIn). Font: JetBrains Mono. Design tokens: packages/styles/src/tokens.css.

Supabase tables: thoughts, atoms, metrics_cache, status_checks, favorite_numbers. Env vars: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ADMIN_PASSWORD, GITHUB_TOKEN, WAKATIME_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET, TYPEFULLY_API_KEY. Dev: 'pnpm turbo dev --filter=@anipotts/www'. Build: 'pnpm build'. Cron routes: /api/metrics/cron, /api/status/cron.

Admin: Cmd+Shift+A. Terminal: Ctrl+`. Use text-body NOT text-white for theme-compatible text. PostHog on www only. STRICT WRITING: Never use em dashes. Never list exactly 3 items. Bundled UI components (tsup splitting:false) must receive theme/callbacks as props, not use hooks internally (context isolation issue).

Typefully API via @anipotts/lib/typefully. Platforms: X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon. Content pipeline: Supabase thoughts+atoms tables, content-config/ voice guides. Series: 60s-fix, i-tried-it, quick-tip, stack-update, viral-reel. Anti-corny guardrails enforced.

Footer is single-row signals bar: BASE/FOCUS/MARKET+time. No subdomain links or copyright in footer. Header (ExpandableNav) has no 'ani potts' logo; just nav items right-aligned. Subdomain pages should NOT have their own title headings (e.g. no 'THOUGHTS' h1 on thoughts page). All pages share identical header+footer layout.

Agent teams enabled (CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1). Teammate mode: in-process. Custom agents in .claude/agents/ require YAML frontmatter with 'name' field. User prefers agent teams over subagents for codebase analysis.

Consolidated 13 memories down to 7. Removed raw message/response noise, merged architecture with the new unified layout decisions, added a new `ui_decisions` memory capturing the footer/header choices
cool commit and push everything to main
